notes: Bounded warm measurements under concurrent GPU load. Excludes disk output and molecular assembly.

cp16.precision: float32 factors from float16 cache, TF32 enabled, float32 accumulation/output
cp16.scope: matrix multiplication plus affine scaling; factors resident on GPU; repeated tile, no output persistence

cp16_with_d2h.scope: same kernel plus every float32 score transferred to pinned CPU memory, no disk writes

cp16_distinct.scope: All distinct row combinations within a real two-slot reaction subset; batched 4096x4096 matrix multiplication plus affine, resident factors, float32 scores; output discarded after each block. Molecular identity duplicates not removed.
